title: Practice 3: Setting out: пойти, поехать — and сходить, съездить

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: The bird picked up the twig with its beak and flew to its nest.
exercises.why: The perfective aspect of "Going Verbs" is formed by adding the prefix "по" to the actual function verbs ("идти", "ехать", etc.). The perfective verbs пойти and поехать denote a single action with emphasis on the completed start. (Similar to the English concept of "to leave for"; "to set out"). The perfective verb полететь (like пойти and поехать) denotes single action with the emphasis on the completed start. The past perfective (полетел, -ла, -ло, -ли) is formed in a regular way. The future perfective (полечу, полетишь) belongs to the 2nd (-и-) type of conjugation. The consonant "т" changes into "ч" in the first person singular only. Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs: ходить,… — DLI, Lesson 54.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.ru: Птица подобрала прутик клювом и ___ к своему гнезду.
exercises.context: The perfective aspect of "Going Verbs" is formed by adding the prefix "по" to the actual function verbs ("идти", "ехать", etc.). (DLI, Lesson 54)

exercises.q: Я хочу ___ (слетать — to fly there and back) на Луну.
exercises.why: The prefix "с-" when added to the "repeated function" verbs — ходить, ездить, летать — forms perfective verbs: сходить, съездить, слетать. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
